answer: The defence is a bonded work gate: a fresh key starts at zero weight and must complete one unit of work that an unrelated peer re-derives and countersigns before its balance or vote counts. Minting a thousand keys buys a thousand bonds and still zero influence, because mutual attestation between keys from one operator is discounted to nothing. Seen from another angle the same logic runs through raven, sable and relic: cost, not count, decides standing, and only work a stranger can re-derive moves an identity forward.
